title: Mimaropa police arrest 8 for illegal LPG sale in Romblon

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police in Mimaropa arrested eight individuals and recovered dozens of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) cylinders in coordinated entrapment operations targeting alleged unauthorized trading, distribution, and counterfeiting of Petron-branded LPG products across Romblon province on Sept. 12. The crackdown was carried out by the municipal police in the towns of Romblon, Looc, Odiongan, and San Agustin, working alongside Petron Corporation brand protection representatives and authorized partners.
